reason: Refuted as stated. The core point holds: '~1/6' came from one lever, the insertion (F-TRN-27 c9), and lab magnitude does not predict the LB. The replacement table the finding wants round agents to cite is wrong in four places. (1) The z-flip lab is +0.0108 (RESULTS l.117), below the +0.012 bar, so 'the bar would have admitted z-flip' is false. Its LB -0.009 (P16) was also read on the exp29 base, while the lab delta came from the exp30->exp31 line. (2) Four of the 9 'wrong-sign' pairs are lab NULLS, not signs: P45 cap 6 -0.00057, P49 cap 8 +0.0006 and P47 cap 12 fc2 (F-TRN-51: every cap arm's CI90 includes 0, and all flip negative without 2 clips; the judge logged it as a NULL), and P18 hygiene +0.0011 (RESULTS l.113 OUTCOME: 'both inside noise, inconclusive'). P41's exp60 lab was also a null (-0.0006/+0.0010). The right-sign count is 5 against about 4-5 real wrong signs, which is about a coin flip, not 'below a coin flip'. (3) Axis-flip also read +0.002 bundled on the takaito base (P25, RESULTS l.58), which the table leaves out. (4) The pairs mix 4 labs (friend B 12 LOEO-44b6, friend A 199 videos, laptop CONFIRMATION, exp60 in-sample) and an other-team LB (744093 truncation). The R8 bar was defined on exp60 only. The 'structural levers 2/2' class is n=2 with post-hoc boundaries (z-flip counts as TTA, the z shift as structural). Written into 29-Sep agent guidance, it invites exactly the post-hoc admission R8 exists to stop. VALUE: 0 on LB and private, because the finding itself changes no build, night step or morning slot. FEASIBILITY: text-only, but it is churn in IDEAS/I-252 on deadline day.
fix: Replace the proposed class table with one narrow annotation, and change no build, night step or morning step. IDEAS header / I-320: 'The ~1/6 ratio is from one lever, the insertion (P28, P35); it is not a transfer law. Lab magnitude did not predict the LB: of the in-sample or local gains >= +0.005, 1 of 6 read positive, and the pairs span 4 different labs. Research-originated items stay out on 29 Sep because of R8, the depth cap {K, SEC, DIS 2.25, CI} and the lack of a read slot before 20:00Z, not because of a numeric lab bar.' Do not publish the 'structural 2/2' or '5/14' lines as guidance. For I-252 and the 30 Sep private-read table, defer any class-level claim until the private reads exist, and list per pair which lab was used, which base, and whether the lab CI included 0.
